video_title: Big Perk calls for the Heat to go for WHO?! ‘GO GET KAWHI LEONARD!’ 👀 | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Edwards could be the next NBA star traded
quotes.excerpt: if you say to me Giannis is now been traded, who would be the next NBA star
quotes.quote: If you say to me Giannis is now been traded, who would be the next NBA star that you would watch? The answer would be Anthony Edwards. Already, Anthony Edwards has watched Karl-Anthony Towns, a player he totally fit with on the court, be traded to the Knicks and win a championship. Last summer, they let Nikil Alexander-Walker go, he goes and wins most improved player down in Atlanta.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota's history of trading away number one draft picks
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota has a track record of letting number one picks go that they drafted

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: We can't overlook that Minnesota has a track record of letting number one picks go that they drafted and they go off other places and win championships. Andrew Wiggins, Kevin Garnett, Karl-Anthony Towns, and even a lottery pick like Kevin Love. But Anthony Edwards, that wasn't just a salary dump with Karl-Anthony Towns, that was getting rid of a toxic environment. Anthony Edwards has belief in Jaden McDaniels and Naz Reid. He's rocking with those guys.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: And by making a trade, are you talking about Ant?

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, I'm talking about going to get some other pieces. Like, I'm talking about going to get a Kyrie Irving.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo cannot win another championship as the primary scorer
quotes.excerpt: Giannis Antetokounmpo will never win another championship with him being the number one scoring option
quotes.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo will never win another championship with him being the number one scoring option. Those days are over. It's not saying that he won't never win another championship, I could see it happen later down the line, but someone else is going to be leading the charge. Jalen Brunson, SGA, Luka, the game has changed. You need perimeter play, you need guys that could get buckets, you need playmakers on the perimeter to deliver.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat should trade for Kawhi Leonard to compete
quotes.excerpt: They need to go get Kawhi Leonard

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: They need to go get Kawhi Leonard. They're probably about to lose Norman Powell because we shouldn't ask him to turn down money. You need a closer. We just saw that. Hell, we could talk about defense, we just saw the defensive player of the year get exposed by big body Brunson. We just saw this tough-nosed Spurs team who defend at a high level, when it came down to it, they didn't have nobody who could close on the offensive end.

text_blocks.speaker: Mike Greenberg
text_blocks.text: And you've been saying these last couple of days, they need to put guys around him.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: They've got to have shot-making and floor-gamers and shot-makers around him.
